Source Monster

Monster: Dodogama | CR: 7 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

(Sorcerer & Wizard Only) Mini-Bombardier. This weapon has 5 runes. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its runes to cast one of the following Spells from it, using your spell save DC: burning hands (1 rune), scorching ray (2 runes), aganazzar’s scorcher (2 runes), or flaming sphere (2 runes). This weapon regains [[/r 1d4 + 1]] expended runes daily at dawn. If you expend the last rune it cannot regain any runes for one week.

Armor Effect

Whenever you make a saving throw against an attack or spell that deals fire damage, you do so with a +2 bonus.
